name: Sahara International Petrochemical Company
summary: Sahara International Petrochemical Company owns, establishes, operates, and manages industrial projects related to chemical and petrochemical industries in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Basic Chemicals, Intermediate Chemicals, Polymers, Marketing, and Corporate and Others segments. It offers basic products, including methanol, butane, and carbon monoxide; and intermediate products, such as acetic acid, vinyl acetate monomer, ethyl acetate, butyl acetate, and utilities.
